core_obligations: The nonempty case (proof lines 2803-2831): the fundamental class of the scheme is the pullback of the fundamental class of the spectrum of the base, so it is one by compatibility of the cycle class map with pullbacks and the computation for the base; to see that one is nonzero one reduces to an irreducible component, chooses a closed point with separable residue field, and computes the pushforward of the class of that point along the structure morphism, obtaining the degree of the residue field extension, which is nonzero; since this factors through the class of the point in the cohomology of the scheme, that cohomology is nonzero.

The empty case (proof lines 2833-2845): the product formula for the empty scheme shows that its cohomology is either zero or one dimensional in degree zero; the same formula applied to the product with a nonempty scheme, together with the nonvanishing just proved and the dimension count in the axioms, forces the cohomology of the empty scheme to vanish.
proof_roadmap: Compute the fundamental class as the pullback of the class of the base.
Use a closed point with separable residue field to produce a nonzero class.
Rule out the one dimensional possibility for the empty scheme by a product argument.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the cohomology of the empty scheme vanishes and that for a nonempty smooth projective scheme the fundamental class is one and the unit is nonzero (statement lines 2799-2806). The proof (proof lines 2807-2845) computes the fundamental class by pullback, produces a nonzero class from a closed point with separable residue field, and eliminates the alternative for the empty scheme by a product argument. H3: two cases with an explicit nonzero class computation, written out in full.
